paragraphs: Rav Yehudah bar Abba, an Amora.

Mentioned in [Menachot 31b](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.31b.4), asking, “Between one column and the next, what is the rule?” Hyman reports Rabbi Yirmiyah bar Akha in Dikdukei Soferim and Rav Yehudah bar Ada in the Rif, Hilkhot Sefer Torah. He says Yuchasin does not list him.

notes.text: שבעי is “who asked,” not “seven.” Yuchasin’s failure to list him is Hyman’s assertion.

The linked Gemara names Rav Yehudah bar Abba as the one who asks about a tear between columns or lines. [Heilprin](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1683&lang=en) cites the same daf and the Rif’s bar Ada, and says he did not find a statement in Rav’s name there. The linked Gemara likewise gives a question without a citation of Rav.
